title: Para-substituted benzoic acid ruthenium(II) complexes: structural features modulating cytotoxicity
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,19763-19778
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07271A, Paper

Jocely L. Dutra, Pedro H. S. Marcon, Gustavo Moselli, Fabiano M. Niquini, João Victor F. da Costa, Carlos André F. Moraes, Ataualpa A. C. Braga, Javier Ellena, Alzir A. Batista, João Honorato de Araujo-Neto
Electronic fine-tuning of Ru(II) complexes drives redox behavior and anticancer activity, with RuNH2 emerging as a highly selective, submicromolar candidate that outperforms cisplatin and stands out as a promising agent for ovarian cancer therapy.
